mechanism: Cyclosporine inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism and may reduce CoQ10 levels; CoQ10 may theoretically enhance immunosuppression or affect cyclosporine metabolism through P-glycoprotein interactions.
action: Monitor cyclosporine levels and immunosuppressive efficacy; if CoQ10 is used for statin-induced myopathy, ensure adequate cyclosporine monitoring and consider alternative approaches.
